Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men – Premium Cotton Pique Comfort

Upgrade your everyday wardrobe with the Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men, designed for men who value comfort, durability, and timeless style. Crafted with Composition – 100% Cotton and made using premium Pique Fabric, this polo T-shirt delivers a refined texture, breathable feel, and long-lasting performance. With a solid GSM : 230, it strikes the perfect balance between lightweight comfort and structured durability, making it ideal for daily wear, office casuals, weekend outings, and smart-casual occasions.

The Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men features a distinctive Dual Tone Effect that adds depth and modern appeal to your look. The subtle contrast elevates the classic polo design, making it suitable for both relaxed and semi-formal settings. Enhanced with a Bio-Washed finish, the fabric feels exceptionally soft against the skin while reducing shrinkage and maintaining color vibrancy even after multiple washes.

Built with Two Tuck Pique knitting technology, this polo T-shirt offers improved fabric strength and a neat, premium appearance. The pique weave allows better air circulation, keeping you cool and comfortable throughout the day. Whether paired with jeans, chinos, or trousers, the Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men adapts effortlessly to your personal style.

Why Choose Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men?

  • 100% Cotton Polo T-Shirt for Men for natural softness and breathability
  • Premium Pique Fabric with rich texture and durability
  • Comfortable 230 GSM fabric for all-season wear
  • Stylish Dual Tone Effect for a modern, versatile look
  • Bio-Washed cotton for enhanced softness and color retention
  • Durable Two Tuck Pique construction for long-lasting use
  • Classic polo collar with button placket for a smart-casual finish
  • Ideal for office wear, casual outings, and everyday styling

Premium Fabric & Superior Comfort

Made from high-quality cotton, the Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men ensures excellent moisture absorption and breathability, keeping you fresh even during long hours of wear. The pique fabric structure enhances airflow while adding a subtle, premium pattern to the surface. Thanks to its GSM : 230, this polo maintains its shape without feeling heavy, making it suitable for year-round use.

The Bio-Washed treatment minimizes fabric stiffness and helps prevent pilling, ensuring that your polo T-shirt looks new for longer. Combined with the Two Tuck Pique knit, it delivers superior strength and resistance to wear and tear, making it a reliable choice for daily use.

Style That Works Everywhere

The Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men is designed to seamlessly transition from casual to smart-casual looks. Wear it with denim for a relaxed weekend vibe or pair it with tailored chinos for a polished, semi-formal appearance. The dual tone effect adds subtle sophistication, while the classic polo silhouette ensures timeless appeal.

Care & Maintenance

  • Machine wash with similar colors
  • Use mild detergent to maintain fabric quality
  • Avoid bleach for long-lasting color
  • Iron at low temperature if required

Choose the Jack & Jones Viktor Polo T-Shirt For Men if you are looking for a premium cotton polo that combines style, comfort, and durability. With its high-quality pique fabric, modern dual tone design, and reliable construction, this polo T-shirt is a must-have essential for every modern man’s wardrobe.
